n.exclusions: Eight prior participants excluded; p. 2129, note 5. Table 1 N is the remaining sample.

notes: Target is the condition-by-anxiety interaction, not either simple slope. Original study is Study 1 for both assigned effects; replication samples are distinct. Original beta = −0.42 is also printed, but the requested printed t statistic is retained. Original recruitment N = 56 is not silently treated as an established post-exclusion analytic N. Replication effect sizes are author-derived values printed in the primary paper Table 1; no conversion performed. Cached sources are web-tool parses of the full original PDF and author-uploaded replication full text. Titles and DOIs match the supplied references.
